app.name: YouTube Studio Assistant
app.tagline: Plan, write and understand your channel — without the guesswork.
app.draftNotice: This translation is a draft that a native speaker has not reviewed yet. Some wording may be wrong.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your Google account. Signing in does not give us access to your YouTube channel — you connect that separately, and only if you choose to.
signIn.notConfigured: Google sign-in isn't configured on this server yet. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and AUTH_SECRET.

error.AccessDenied: Sign-in was cancelled, or your Google email address isn't verified.
error.Configuration: Sign-in is misconfigured on the server. Please try again later.
error.OAuthAccountNotLinked: This email is already linked to a different sign-in method.
error.Verification: That sign-in link has expired. Please try again.
error.Default: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

channels.title: Your channels
channels.subtitle: Connect a YouTube channel so we can read its videos and analytics. We only ask for read access and never post to YouTube.
channels.roundedNote: YouTube rounds subscriber counts to three significant figures.
channels.needsReauth: Access expired — reconnect to keep this channel up to date.
channels.privacyNote: Disconnecting revokes our access at Google and keeps the data we already stored, so reconnecting later picks up where you left off.

flash.disconnected: Channel disconnected and our access at Google revoked.
flash.disconnectedAlreadyInvalid: Channel disconnected. Our access had already been removed at Google.
flash.disconnectRevokeFailed: Channel disconnected here, but we couldn't reach Google to revoke access. Please remove “YouTube Studio Assistant” at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
flash.OAUTH_DENIED: You cancelled on Google's screen, so nothing was connected.
flash.OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: That connection link expired or was already used. Please start again.
flash.OAUTH_FAILED: Google didn't complete the connection. Please try again.
flash.YOUTUBE_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: Both permissions are needed: reading your channel and reading its analytics. Please try again and leave both boxes ticked.
flash.YOUTUBE_NO_CHANNEL: That Google account doesn't have a YouTube channel. If your channel belongs to a brand account, choose it on Google's account screen.
flash.YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: We've reached today's YouTube data limit. Please try again tomorrow.
flash.CHANNEL_LIMIT: You've reached your plan's channel limit. Disconnect a channel or upgrade to add another.
flash.CHANNEL_OWNED: That channel is already connected to a different account here. It can be connected to only one account at a time.
flash.CONFIGURATION_MISSING: Channel connection isn't configured on this server yet.
flash.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
flash.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: Google is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
flash.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
flash.syncQueued: Refresh queued. New videos and statistics will appear in a minute or two.
flash.YOUTUBE_REAUTH_REQUIRED: Access to this channel expired. Reconnect it to refresh.
flash.NOT_FOUND: That channel isn't connected any more.

syncStatus.FAILED: Last sync failed — it will retry automatically

errors.unauthenticated: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.validationFailed: Some of the information you entered isn't valid.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {retryAfter} seconds.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Reference: {requestId}
errors.upstreamUnavailable: A service we depend on is temporarily unavailable.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.configurationMissing: This feature isn't configured on this server yet.

ai.limitReached: You've used all your generations for this month. Your limit resets on {resetAt}.
ai.invalidOutput: We couldn't generate that. Please try again.
ai.refused: The AI couldn't help with that request. Try rephrasing it.
ai.notConfigured: AI features aren't set up on this server yet.

youtube.reauthRequired: Your YouTube connection expired. Reconnect your channel to keep syncing.
youtube.insufficientScope: We need permission to read your YouTube analytics. Please reconnect and approve access.
youtube.quotaExceeded: Data updates are paused for today and will resume automatically.
youtube.noChannel: That Google account doesn't have a YouTube channel.

oauth.stateInvalid: That connection link expired or was already used. Please start again.
oauth.failed: Google didn't complete the connection. Please try again.

channels.limitReached: You've reached your plan's limit of {limit} channels.
channels.ownedByAnotherUser: That channel is already connected to another account.

validation.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type.
validation.invalid_enum_value: Choose one of the allowed options.
validation.invalidJson: The request body isn't valid JSON.

content.needsScheduleDate: Set a date and time before marking this as scheduled.
content.ideaPromoted: This idea is already a project, so it stays with the project.
content.tooManyProjects: You've reached the maximum number of active projects. Archive some to add more.
content.tooManyVersions: This has reached the maximum number of versions. Start a new project or keep editing the selected one.
content.assetTooLong: That text is longer than allowed for this kind of asset.
content.generationFailed: That AI result didn't complete, so there's nothing to add.
content.notAnAsset: This kind of AI result can't be added to a project.
content.compareSameKind: Only versions of the same kind can be compared.

videos.title: Videos
videos.emptyPending: No videos yet — the first sync is queued or running. This page fills in as it completes.
videos.shortFormHint: By length only — YouTube does not say which videos are Shorts.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.planLimited: Your plan includes {days} days of analytics history.
analytics.dataThrough: Final figures through {date}. The last few days may still change — YouTube takes 2–3 days to finish counting.
analytics.noFinalData: YouTube is still processing these days. Figures may change.
analytics.empty: No analytics yet. The first sync runs shortly after you connect a channel; YouTube data also arrives 2–3 days late, so a brand-new channel may take a few days to show anything.
analytics.noComparison: Not enough earlier data to compare

charts.subscribers: Subscribers gained minus lost, per day
charts.subscribersWeekly: Subscribers gained minus lost, per week

topVideos.title: Top videos in this period
topVideos.note: Daily figures are collected for recent uploads and your top videos, so older, quieter videos may not appear here.
topVideos.empty: No per-video figures for this period yet.

analytics.limitations: YouTube's API doesn't provide impressions or click-through rate, so they aren't shown here. Revenue isn't requested.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Get ideas, titles, descriptions, scripts and plans for your videos. Everything you generate is saved to your history.

fields.topicHint: For example: "the best breakfast stalls in Phnom Penh"
fields.title: Video title
fields.goal: What do you want to achieve?
fields.goalHint: For example: "grow to 1,000 subscribers" or "bring more customers to my restaurant"

studio.languageNote: Results in Khmer, Thai, Vietnamese or Chinese may need more editing than English.
studio.channelNote: Using a channel gives the AI its niche, audience, typical video length and best recent titles. It never sends viewer data.
studio.generating: Generating… this can take up to a minute
studio.noneLeft: No uses left this month for this tool. Resets {date}.

errors.AI_LIMIT_REACHED: You've used this month's allowance for this tool.
errors.AI_REFUSED: The AI couldn't help with that request. Try rephrasing it.
errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI's answer didn't come out right. Please try again — this didn't use your allowance.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is busy or unavailable right now. Please try again shortly — this didn't use your allowance.
errors.CONFIGURATION_MISSING: AI features aren't set up on this server yet.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a minute.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the form — something is missing or too long.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

studio.forProject: Working on “{title}”. On the result page you can add what you generate to this project.

results.cached: You asked for this recently, so here is the same result again. It did not use your allowance.
results.failed: This request didn't produce a result.

titles.strengthNote: The estimate is the AI's opinion, not a measurement of how the title will perform.

description.copyHint: Select the text to copy it into YouTube Studio.

toProject.heading: Add to a project
toProject.none: Create a project first to collect results in it.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.subtitle: Ideas you saved from Studio or wrote yourself. Start a project when one is worth making.
ideas.emptyHint: Generate some in Studio, or add one above.

projects.subtitle: Every video you are working on, by stage.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Start one here, or from an idea.

fields.title: Working title
fields.scheduledHint: Leave empty if not decided yet.

assets.heading: Titles, description and script
assets.intro: Each change is kept as a new version. Select the one you will use.

calendar.heading: On the calendar
calendar.none: Nothing on the calendar for this project.

danger.body: The project disappears from your board and calendar. Its ideas go back to your idea list.

compare.title: Compare versions
compare.legend: Lines only in version {before} are marked −, lines only in version {after} are marked +.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Scheduled videos and your own reminders.

add.heading: Add to the calendar
add.title: What
add.timeHint: Leave empty for an all-day item.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Signed in as {email}.

you.heading: You
you.languageHint: The language of menus, buttons and messages.
you.timezoneHint: Publish dates and the calendar use this.

content.heading: Your content
content.languageHint: Studio and new projects start in this language. You can still change it each time.
content.channelHint: Studio uses this channel unless you choose another.

channels.heading: About your channels
channels.intro: Tell the AI tools what each channel is about, so their suggestions fit it.

settings.usageLink: See what you have used this month

channelSettings.title: About “{channel}”
channelSettings.intro: The AI tools use these answers for every suggestion for this channel. Short, plain answers work best, and you can change them any time.
channelSettings.nicheHint: For example: street food in Phnom Penh.
channelSettings.audienceHint: For example: visitors planning a trip, and locals looking for new places.
channelSettings.voice: How do you talk to viewers?
channelSettings.voiceHint: For example: warm and funny, never pushy.
channelSettings.privacy: This is sent to the AI with your requests, together with a summary of your channel: how often you post, how long your videos usually are, and the titles of your best recent videos with how they did compared with your average. Nothing else from your channel is sent, and never your viewers’ data.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.subtitle: Plan, write and keep track of your videos in one place.

checklist.heading: Getting started
checklist.allDone: You're all set. Everything below is ready when you need it.

connectChannel.title: Connect your YouTube channel
connectChannel.why: We read your videos and statistics (never change anything) so advice fits your channel.

describeChannel.title: Say what your channel is about
describeChannel.why: Two or three short answers make every AI suggestion more useful.

firstIdeas.title: Get your first video ideas
firstIdeas.why: Type a topic and the AI suggests ideas you can save.

startProject.title: Turn an idea into a project
startProject.why: A project keeps the title, description and script for one video together.

scheduleVideo.title: Pick a publish date
scheduleVideo.why: Scheduled videos appear on your calendar, so you can see what is coming.

shortcuts.heading: Go to
shortcuts.studio: Studio: generate ideas, titles, descriptions and scripts
shortcuts.projects: Projects: everything you are working on
shortcuts.usage: Usage: what you have used this month

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: What you have used, and what is left.

ai.heading: AI tools this month
ai.fairness: A use only counts when you get a result. If something fails, it is not counted. Asking the exact same thing again within a day reuses the earlier result for free.

usage.unavailable: Usage isn't available right now. Please try again later.

youtube.heading: YouTube data
youtube.body: Your videos and statistics update automatically. Google limits how much data every app can read each day. If that limit is reached, updates pause and continue after midnight Pacific time. Nothing is lost.
youtube.delay: YouTube publishes analytics two to three days late, so the most recent days are always marked as not final.
